_doc: Fallback ladder for box8 mode (deploy/routeB_cloud/routeB/ladder.py reads this; the plan agent and the budget governor share it). A failed fit interval is re-covered by the NEXT rung that is narrower than the failed interval (or is flagged same_span). width: 'full' = whole requested z range | integer = stripe height in z slices, tiled with `overlap` (stripe starts every width-overlap). tag: segment-name stem, tiles are <scroll>_<tag>_wNNN_zRRxC exactly as tile_windings.py/register_tiles.py/postwindow.sh name them (q-series = 4500/1500, sw-series = 2800/200: production names PHerc0125_q4500v1_w010..., PHerc0125_sw4500_w010...). gpuh_factor = expected GPU-h of ONE stripe of this rung as a fraction of the scroll's full-width fit (base 5.99 GPU-h x shell/125 from f0125_res_flowonly, n = 1; quarter p50 2.5 h / 5.99 = 0.42 from 30 converged quarter fits; 2800 factor 0.30 is an EXTRAPOLATION, unmeasured). p_complete is for the plan agent to fill from history (null = unknown, the governor does not use it). expected_gpuh_override: {scroll: {rung: hours}} replaces the formula.

limits.tracks_per_gb_source: plan agent: ~2.0 M tracks/GB ASSUMED (1.5-2.5) for unfit scrolls; PHerc0191 22.76M in 9.9 GB = 2.3

rungs.name: full
rungs.note: fit.overrides() already sets model_flow_voxel_resolution 32 above 6000 slices

rungs.name: w13000
rungs.note: ASSUMED reading of the coordinator's '13,000' rung: same span as full with a leaner memory profile (fewer tracks/step, coarser flow grid). Edit here if a different meaning was intended.

payload_gb._source: PHerc0211 f0211_full: meshes 563 MB + tiled 224 MB = 0.79 GB (n = 1); narrower rungs scaled by span, ASSUMED

_ladder_doc: Default ladder full -> sw2800 (plan agent: 2800 stripes are cheapest per area, 4500 is dominated by 2800). Pass --ladder full,w13000,q4500,sw2800 (or --ladder all) to keep the other rungs.
plan_data_source: docs/experiments/readerB_2026-10-08/data/box8_rungs.json (plan agent ad2d01716e65a8118, 2026-10-08): per scroll and rung gpu_h_p10/p50/p90 for the WHOLE rung (n_stripes stripes), p_complete per stripe. Per-stripe expected hours = quantile / n_stripes.
detect_early: fit.log line 'loaded N tracks within z-roi' (appears ~3-5 min in): N > multinomial_categories kills the job at once and descends (class multinomial)
